consent.title: Before we start
consent.purpose: We keep your name and a code made from your face only to find you again, reunite your family and record what you receive here.
consent.retention: The data is erased 30 days after the event ends.
consent.access: Only the people working in this shelter and the network of confirmed shelters see your record.
consent.unconfirmed: Shelter not confirmed by the Civil Defense
consent.no_police: The data is not shared with the police or with immigration.
consent.refusal_ok: Refusing the selfie does not take away shelter or donations.
consent.short: I will keep your name and a code of your face to find you again. The data does not go to the police or immigration. If you do not want the selfie, you keep shelter and donations.
consent.basis_vital_interest: Person is injured or cannot answer
consent.privacy_intro: This is the full text about your data in Taba.
consent.privacy_s1_body: Name, social name, wristband number, year of birth, health needs marked yes or no, vulnerability situation and, when you accept, a code made from your face. The photo never stays on the server.
consent.privacy_s2_body: To find you again, reunite your family, know who is in the shelter and record what you receive.
consent.privacy_s3_body: Your consent. If you are injured or cannot answer, the protection of life. For children, child protection (LGPD, art. 11 and art. 14).
consent.privacy_s4_body: People who work in this shelter and the network of confirmed shelters. A shelter not yet confirmed only sees what it registered itself.
consent.privacy_s5_body: Data is erased 30 days after the event ends. Thumbnails of people without identification are erased when the event ends.
consent.privacy_s6_body: Your data is not shared with the police or with immigration.
consent.privacy_s7_body: Declining the selfie does not take away shelter or donations. You are registered by name or wristband and can change your mind later.
consent.privacy_s8_body: Registering a child who is alone or apart from the family alerts child protection and the Civil Defense, so that no child is left without care.
consent.privacy_s9_body: You can ask to see, correct or erase your data. Talk to a volunteer or to the pilot responsible.
